programs.desc: Political commentator and Rachael's friend S.E. Cupp joins Rachael in her upstate kitchen to learn how to prepare Chicken Scarpiello, a classic Italian-American chicken dish that is baked and sautéed alongside sausages and onions.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes
programs.desc: Features Rachel demonstrating how to make takeout at home and how to stock the pantry for the recipe called Chicken Chow Fun, a Chinese-American takeout favorite with a rice-noodle base, chicken and vegetables.
